sources.entry: Thingsboard - IoT Platform - Device management, data collection, processing and visualization. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: ThingsBoard is an all-in-one IoT platform for collecting, processing, visualizing and managing data from connected devices, installable on-premises or used as ThingsBoard Cloud.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ThingsBoard as a platform for device and asset provisioning and management through server-side APIs, with relations defined between devices, assets, and customers. It collects and stores telemetry data and visualizes it with built-in or custom widgets and flexible dashboards, which can be shared with customers. It includes SCADA-style dashboards with symbols for monitoring and controlling industrial processes in real time. A rule engine built from rule chains processes device data, and calculated fields compute values, aggregates and KPIs. Alarms can be triggered on thresholds, telemetry events, attribute updates, or device inactivity, with notifications via email, SMS, mobile apps, or third-party integrations.
use_cases: manage and provision IoT devices and assets
collect and store sensor telemetry data
trigger alarms and notifications on device data
fleet tracking and smart metering solutions
how_to_run: Install ThingsBoard on-premises (see the README's installation options and documentation)
notable: Rule engine with rule chains for processing device data
Calculated fields for real-time metrics and KPIs from device and asset data
Built-in solution templates for use cases such as smart energy and farming
caveats: Starting with version 4.4 the license is BUSL 1.1; production use beyond the Additional Use Grant, or removing branding, requires a commercial license
summary.license: Apache-2.0 for versions before 4.4; BUSL 1.1 for 4.4 and later
